The interface ara::crypto::IOInterface::-
IsValid shall only return TRUE, if the underlying resource this IOInterface points
to is a VolatileTrustedContainer or a KeySlot that has not been modified since this
IOInterface has been obtained by calling ara::crypto::keys::KeySlot::Open
on the loaded KeySlot instance.
